messages:
maria: FYI — Hyperscaler marketplace team asked for a joint perf benchmark next week for our small quantized models. They want perf/W, sustained throughput at 8k tokens, and 'realistic workload' traces. Kickoff call?
partner-bot: New integration request from hyperscaler@marketplace — due 2026-04-05. Link: https://hyperscaler.example/req/12345
chris: What's the scope of "realistic workload"? CPU pre/post processing included? batching limits?
leo: Hardware partner says TDP set to 250W for nodes; they will allow kernel tuning but only non-invasive patches. We'll have isolated test racks Thu/Fri.
sam: Marketplace needs an artifacts bundle (csv of runs, SLO graphs, short readme) + a 1-page summary for listing. Also legal wants a short IP note.
joy: I'll draft a runbook template. For quick runs use our bench script:
```
./bench --model redwood-small-quant --seq 8192 --batch 8 --profile power --output csv
```
chris: I'll queue the job Friday morning. Need the exact kernel + CUDA versions. leo, can you confirm matrix?
leo: Kernel/CUDA: ubuntu-22.04, linux 5.19, CUDA 12.3, cuDNN 9.2. Tuning checklist: disable cstates, set governor performance, pin CPUs, set hugepages. Telemetry endpoint: http://10.4.0.2:9000/telemetry (auth token in shared drive).
sam: Can marketing for marketplace collaterals join the call? They'll want a draft blurb and approved numbers.
maria: OK — scheduling 30m kickoff Weds 09:30 PT. Action items: @chris run baseline w/ current kernel Thursday; @leo provide tuned kernel steps + perf knobs by EOD Wed; @joy draft runbook and artifact checklist. I'll invite marketplace PM and legal. :calendar:
partner-bot: Meeting created — "Marketplace bench kickoff" Wed 09:30 PT. Invitees: maria, chris, leo, joy, sam, marketplace-pm
